July 26, 1956, Alexandria, Egypt - Announced the nationalization of the Suez Canal - Considered one of his most famous and consequential speeches 2. **Assassination Attempt Speech** - October 26, 1954, Alexandria, Egypt - Delivered during a Muslim Brotherhood assassination attempt - Broadcast to the Arab world, demonstrating his courage under fire 3. **Afro-Asian Youth Conference Speech** - February 2, 1958, Cairo, Egypt - If the range were expanded slightly (1895-1920), it would capture most of the major Northern African anti-colonial leaders who became presidents, including Nasser (1918) and potentially others. The research demonstrates that Northern African independence movements were led by individuals across multiple generational cohorts, with the most prominent presidential figures often falling just outside the specified birth year parameters.
